scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/engine typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/protocol typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/sdk typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/server typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/fight typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/frontend typecheck
scripts.coverage:typescript: bun test packages scripts --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir=coverage --reporter=dots && bun scripts/assert_coverage.mjs coverage/lcov.info
